Specifications: "Frame width Adjustable from 41.3" to 72.2""; "Frame depth 27.6" for 30" deep desktops"; "Frame height (not including desktop) 21.6" to 47.7""; "Note: Casters increase desk height by 1.5" to 4.7"."; "Travel range 26.1""; "Bamboo desktops are 1" thick."; "Lifting capacity 355 lb (inclusive of desktop weights)"
dimensions.source: upliftdesk.com's V3 Standing Desk configurator and its Specifications section, read in Claude in Chrome 2026-11-08 with Bamboo 1" and 60" x 30" selected (the SKU printed under the desktop options). w 60 and d 30 are the desktop; h 51.2 is the frame's 47.7" plus the 1" bamboo top plus the 2.5" of the Soft Roll Casters in Andrew's cart (the page's own range with a 1" top is 22.6" to 48.7"; on these casters 25.1" to 51.2").

notes: In Andrew's UPLIFT cart, qty 1 (2026-11-08, his screenshots): "UPLIFT V3 Standing Desk" $908: Desktop Style +$100 Bamboo - Bamboo 1"; Desktop Size +$160 60" x 30"; Grommets 2 Covers - Black; Frame Color V3 C-Frame 27.5" feet - Black; Keypad Basic Display Angled Keypad - Black; Casters +$49 Soft Roll Casters - Black, raises desk 2.5"; Assembly Help I don't need assembly help; free accessories Bamboo Rocker-X Board (without comfort mat), Standing Desk Mat, Bamboo Desk Drawer - Natural, Clamp-On Cup Holder - Black. The page, 2026-11-08: $859 with Bamboo 1" and 60 x 30 on the default frame and Basic Display keypad, so the cart's $908 is that plus the casters' $49. The cart's coupon BF2026 takes $200 off a $1,999+ subtotal, $300 off $2,999+ ("Sale ends 11/29/2026"). The url is the configurator with Bamboo 1" and 60 x 30 selected. Every V3 includes the FlexMount Cable Manager and 10 cable wraps. Ships flat in boxes, as the 80 x 30.
